figures.ask_en: What is this diagram, and how is it organised?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖是什麼？它是怎麼組織的？
figures.a_en: Our stakeholder map: everyone we engaged with, grouped into four lobes around ReLEAF. Farmers and target customers hold Ms. Chen Hui-Wen, Mr. Chen Ke-Wei and the growers we met; the other lobes hold the academics, the companies and the public bodies. The count stands at 31 after the French Office in Taipei was added on 21 October. It is the map we use to show that the advice came from more than one kind of person.
figures.a_zh: 這是我們的利害關係人地圖：所有接觸過的對象，以 ReLEAF 為中心分成四大區塊。農民與目標顧客那一區有陳惠文女士、陳科維先生與我們拜訪過的農友；其他區塊則是學界、業界與公部門。10 月 21 日把法國在台辦事處加進來之後，總數是 31 位。我們用這張圖說明：建議不是只來自同一種人。
opt_en: The stakeholder map: everyone the team engaged with, grouped into four categories
The influence-interest grid used to prioritise stakeholder attention
The evolution map showing how the project design changed over the year
The seat map for the judging session
opt_zh: 利害關係人地圖：團隊接觸過的所有對象，分成四大類
用來排定關注優先序的影響力—興趣矩陣
呈現專題設計整年演變的演化地圖
評審會談的座位分配圖
figures.trap_en: Confusing it with the influence-interest grid on the Entrepreneurship page. That one places people by power and interest; this one simply groups who we talked to.
figures.trap_zh: 跟創業頁上的影響力—興趣矩陣搞混。那一張是依權力與興趣定位；這一張只是把談過的對象分組。

figures.ask_en: What is this, why LINE, and what are the six buttons for?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼？為什麼用 LINE？那六個按鈕是做什麼的？
figures.a_en: The main menu of 農友助手, our LINE official account. Six functions: Latest News, Product Introduction, Crop Stress Alerts, Crop Assistant, Farmer's Diary and Feedback. We built it because the Farmer Expo and Ms. Chen Hui-Wen's interview told us the same thing: the information exists on government pages and websites, but many smallholders are not comfortable finding it. LINE is already on their phones, so one tap takes them to the right page.
figures.a_zh: 這是我們的 LINE 官方帳號「農友助手」的主選單，六個功能：最新消息、產品介紹、壓力警報、作物小幫手、農友日記、意見回饋。我們會做這個，是因為農夫市集與陳惠文女士的訪談都指向同一件事：資訊在政府網頁跟各種網站上都有，但很多小農不習慣去找。LINE 本來就在他們手機裡，點一下就能連到該看的那一頁。
kw_en: LINE official account 農友助手
kw_zh: LINE 官方帳號 農友助手
figures.q_en: Why did the team build this on LINE rather than as its own app?
figures.q_zh: 團隊為什麼把這個做在 LINE 上，而不是自己做一個 app？
opt_en: Because smallholders already use LINE, so the information needs no new app to reach them
Because LINE is the only platform that allows automated weather alerts in Taiwan
Because an app would have required a government licence
Because the team could not afford app store fees
opt_zh: 因為小農本來就在用 LINE，資訊不需要再裝一個新 app 才送得到
因為在台灣只有 LINE 能做自動天氣警報
因為自己做 app 需要政府核可
因為團隊付不起 app 商店的費用
figures.trap_en: Presenting it as a technical choice. It is a Human Practices decision: the platform was chosen from what the farmers we met actually use.
figures.trap_zh: 把它講成技術選擇。這是人文實踐的決定：平台是根據我們訪談到的農民實際在用什麼而選的。

figures.ask_en: What was asked here, how many people answered, and what does the green bar mean?
figures.ask_zh: 這題問的是什麼？有多少人回答？綠色那條代表什麼？
figures.a_en: A knowledge question from our booth KAP survey: which region of Taiwan has the highest plant stress. Yilan County, the correct answer, is the tall green bar at 51.6 percent, 32 of 62 respondents. Kaohsiung is 19.4 percent, Taichung 17.7 and Tainan 11.3, all grey. Total responses 62. It measures whether the stress map we showed actually landed, not whether people liked the booth.
figures.a_zh: 這是我們攤位 KAP 問卷裡的知識題：台灣哪一個地區的植物逆境最嚴重。正確答案宜蘭縣是最高的綠色長條，51.6%，62 人中有 32 人答對。高雄 19.4%、台中 17.7%、台南 11.3%，都是灰色。總回應數 62。它量的是我們展示的逆境地圖有沒有真的傳達出去，而不是大家喜不喜歡這個攤位。
figures.q_en: What does the green bar mark in this chart?
figures.q_zh: 這張圖裡的綠色長條標的是什麼？
opt_en: The correct answer, Yilan County, chosen by 51.6 percent of 62 respondents
The region where the team ran its field visits
The answer given by the farmers, as opposed to the general public
The region with the largest rice-growing area
opt_zh: 正確答案宜蘭縣，62 位受訪者中有 51.6% 選了它
團隊進行田間拜訪的地區
農民（相對於一般民眾）所給的答案
稻作面積最大的地區
figures.trap_en: Reading 51.6 percent as a success without the denominator. Sixty-two responses is a small sample and should be said out loud.
figures.trap_zh: 把 51.6% 當成成功卻不講分母。62 份回應是小樣本，要主動講出來。

figures.ask_en: Whose survey is this, and what is the weakness of a result like this?
figures.ask_zh: 這是誰的問卷結果？這種結果的弱點在哪裡？
figures.a_en: The farmers' KAP results from our public forum: knowledge, attitude and practice all at 80 percent. We also surveyed the speakers, who scored 100 across all three, and the general public, at 90, 95 and 100. The weakness is that these are self-reported post-event scores with no pre-event baseline for this audience, so they measure agreement on the day rather than change. Our elementary school lessons do have a matched pre and post survey, and that is the stronger dataset.
figures.a_zh: 這是公眾論壇上農民的 KAP 問卷結果：知識、態度、行為三項都是 80%。我們也調查了講者（三項都是 100%）與一般民眾（90%、95%、100%）。弱點在於：這些是活動後的自評分數，這一群受訪者沒有活動前的基線，所以它量到的是當天的認同度，不是改變量。我們在國小課程那邊才有配對的前後測問卷，那組資料比較紮實。
kw_en: the school lessons have pre and post
kw_zh: 論壇農民 KAP 三項皆 80%
figures.q_en: What is the honest limitation of this forum KAP result?
figures.q_zh: 這份論壇 KAP 結果誠實來講的限制是什麼？
opt_en: It is a post-event self-report with no matched pre-event baseline for this audience
The sample was drawn only from the team's own school
The questions were asked in English, which farmers could not read
The scores were estimated by the team rather than collected
opt_zh: 這是活動後的自評，這群受訪者沒有配對的活動前基線
樣本只來自團隊自己的學校
問卷是用英文問的，農民看不懂
分數是團隊估的，不是實際蒐集來的
figures.trap_en: Quoting a flat 80 percent as impact. Without a baseline it is agreement, not change; point to the pre/post school data for change.
figures.trap_zh: 拿一個平平的 80% 當成影響力。沒有基線，那是認同度不是改變；要談改變就指向國小的前後測資料。

figures.ask_en: Who is this, and name one thing in the hardware that exists because of him.
figures.ask_zh: 這是誰？講出一個因為他而存在的硬體設計。
figures.a_en: Professor Chang Jo-Shu's second visit, 4 September 2026, with the bioreactor on the table. We showed him the new progress and two problems: protectant and B. subtilis coming through the hollow fiber membrane with no driving force, and difficulty interpreting our own data. The pinch valve on the culture return exists because of the gap he named in June: the design had no driving force to push product across the membrane. He also pushed us towards usability, AIoT integration and a replaceable bacterial capsule.
figures.a_zh: 這是張嘉修教授 2026 年 9 月 4 日的第二次來訪，桌上就是生物反應器。我們向他說明新的進展，也講了兩個問題：在沒有任何驅動力的情況下保護劑與 B. subtilis 仍會穿過中空纖維膜，以及我們自己的數據難以判讀。菌液回流端的夾管閥之所以存在，就是因為他六月指出的缺口：設計裡沒有任何把產物推過薄膜的驅動力。他也把我們推向易用性、AIoT 整合與可更換的菌種膠囊。
kw_en: no driving force across the membrane
kw_zh: 張嘉修教授，9 月 4 日
figures.q_en: Which hardware change came out of Professor Chang's feedback?
figures.q_zh: 哪一項硬體改動是出自張教授的建議？
opt_en: The pinch valve, which creates the driving force to push product across the membrane
The in-line photometer, which replaced hand sampling
The floating plate in the hydroponic boxes
The light plate apparatus for parallel optogenetic culture
opt_zh: 夾管閥，它製造把產物推過薄膜所需的驅動力
線上光度計，取代人工取樣
水耕盒裡的浮板
做平行光遺傳學培養的光照板裝置
figures.trap_en: Naming a visit without naming what changed. Every IHP photo should come with a before and an after.
figures.trap_zh: 只講拜訪了誰，卻沒講改了什麼。每一張人文實踐的照片都應該附上「之前」與「之後」。

figures.ask_en: What is on this slide, and what safety decision followed from this meeting?
figures.ask_zh: 這張投影片上是什麼？這場會議之後做了什麼安全決定？
figures.a_en: Dr. Jennifer Brophy of Stanford, 18 April. The slide lists the four ways we had considered signalling the bacteria: light, electricity, chemical and sound. Her point on biosafety changed the project: physical containment should be the primary safety mechanism rather than relying on a kill switch. Before, we had planned a kill switch to prevent B. subtilis leakage. After, physical containment became primary, which is why the semi-permeable hollow fiber membrane that retains the cells and passes the protectant is the design we built.
figures.a_zh: 這是史丹佛的 Jennifer Brophy 博士，4 月 18 日。投影片上列的是我們當時考慮過的四種對細菌發訊方式：光、電、化學、聲音。她在生物安全上的意見改變了整個專題：實體圍堵應該是主要的安全機制，而不是依賴自殺開關。在那之前，我們打算用自殺開關防止 B. subtilis 外洩；之後，實體圍堵變成主要機制——這就是為什麼我們最後建的是能留住細胞、讓保護劑通過的半透性中空纖維膜。
kw_en: kill switch out, physical containment in
kw_zh: Brophy 博士，四種發訊選項
figures.q_en: What changed in the project after this meeting?
figures.q_zh: 這場會議之後，專題改變了什麼？
opt_en: Physical containment replaced the kill switch as the primary biosafety mechanism
The team switched the signal from light to a chemical inducer
The team added a second kill switch for redundancy
The bacterial chassis was changed from E. coli to B. subtilis
opt_zh: 實體圍堵取代自殺開關，成為主要的生物安全機制
團隊把訊號從光改成化學誘導物
團隊再加了一個自殺開關做備援
宿主從大腸桿菌換成枯草桿菌
figures.trap_en: Saying the kill switch was abandoned outright. The page says physical containment is primary while whether an additional kill switch is necessary is still being evaluated.
figures.trap_zh: 說自殺開關被完全放棄。頁面寫的是以實體圍堵為主，是否還需要額外的自殺開關仍在評估。

figures.ask_en: What is the slide behind them, and what did this consultation change about how the model and the lab relate?
figures.ask_zh: 他們後面那張投影片是什麼？這次諮詢改變了模型與實驗之間的什麼關係？
figures.a_en: Professor Chen pointing at our own slide titled Auto-filling medium. Before this consultation, the mathematical model and the wet-lab experiments were developed as fairly separate components. After it, we set up a feedback loop between the two: test different salt concentrations and treatment durations to get a dose-time-response relationship, and extend the bioreactor testing period so there is enough data to validate the model against. He also pointed us towards Yes Health iFarm for hydroponics.
figures.a_zh: 這是陳教授指著我們自己那張標題為「自動補液」的投影片。在這次諮詢之前，數學模型與濕實驗基本上是分開發展的兩塊。之後我們在兩者之間建立回饋迴路：測試不同鹽濃度與處理時長，取得劑量—時間—反應的關係；並且延長反應器的測試時間，讓資料足夠用來驗證模型。他也建議我們去看看「源鮮智慧農場」的水耕系統。
kw_en: model and wet lab were separate
kw_zh: 模型與濕實驗原本分開
延長反應器實驗以利驗證
opt_en: The model and the wet lab stopped being separate: a feedback loop was set up between them
The team switched from Arabidopsis to rice as the model plant
The hollow fiber membrane was replaced by a dialysis bag
The project dropped heat stress and kept only salinity
opt_zh: 模型與濕實驗不再各做各的：兩者之間建立了回饋迴路
團隊把模式植物從阿拉伯芥換成水稻
中空纖維膜改成透析袋
專題放棄熱逆境，只保留鹽逆境
figures.trap_en: Describing a visit as encouragement. The useful answer names the working practice that changed.
figures.trap_zh: 把一次拜訪講成「給我們鼓勵」。有用的回答要講出實際改變的做法。

figures.ask_en: Who is speaking here, and name a question from this audience that changed the project.
figures.ask_zh: 這裡發言的是誰？講一個來自這群聽眾、並且改變了專題的問題。
figures.a_en: A farmer taking the microphone from the audience at our public forum. Two of their questions changed work on the wiki. One asked how many bioreactors a farm would actually need, which is why the financial projection on the Entrepreneurship page exists. The other asked whether our solution breaks organic certification rules; we researched the organic regulations and confirmed that it cannot be used on certified organic farms. That led to the online interview with Mr. Chen Ke-Wei of the Lanyang River cooperative.
figures.a_zh: 這是公眾論壇上一位農民從聽眾席拿起麥克風發言。他們提的兩個問題改變了 wiki 上的工作。一個問的是一座農場到底需要幾台反應器——創業頁上的財務推估就是因此而生。另一個問的是我們的方案會不會牴觸有機認證規定；我們去查了有機法規，確認它不能用在通過認證的有機農場上。這也促成後來與蘭陽溪友善耕作合作社陳科維先生的線上訪談。
kw_en: cannot be used on organic farms
kw_zh: 一座農場要幾台反應器
figures.q_en: Which answer came out of a farmer's question at this forum?
figures.q_zh: 哪一個答案是出自這場論壇上農民的提問？
opt_en: That ReLEAF cannot be applied on certified organic farms, confirmed by researching the organic regulations
That the protectant must be applied before the stress, not after
That the hollow fiber pore size should be 0.2 micrometres
That B. subtilis WB800 is the right chassis for secretion
opt_zh: ReLEAF 不能用在通過認證的有機農場上，這是查閱有機法規後確認的
保護劑必須在逆境之前施用，不能在之後
中空纖維的孔徑應該是 0.2 微米
B. subtilis WB800 是適合分泌的宿主
figures.trap_en: Only telling the flattering half. The organic finding is a limit on our own market, and saying it first is what makes the engagement credible.
figures.trap_zh: 只講好聽的那一半。有機那項發現是對我們自己市場的限制，主動先講才讓這段互動有說服力。

figures.ask_en: What is on the screen, and what did this review change about how you explain the twin?
figures.ask_zh: 畫面上是什麼？這次檢視改變了你們解釋數位孿生的哪一件事？
figures.a_en: The 15 October call with Professor Chen, showing the 3D model of the bioreactor cabinet. He challenged us to say why ReLEAF needs a specialised bioreactor at all, and gave positive feedback on the real-time interface and the AI chat. Before, we introduced the digital twin through the textbook definitions of digital model, shadow and twin, and explained hardware and software before the application. After, we lead with the agricultural scenario, the inputs, the outputs and the feedback loop, and only then define the twin.
figures.a_zh: 這是 10 月 15 日與陳教授的線上會議，畫面上是反應器機櫃的 3D 模型。他要我們說清楚 ReLEAF 到底為什麼需要一台專門的反應器，同時對即時監控介面與 AI 對話介面給了正面評價。在那之前，我們是用數位模型、數位陰影、數位孿生這三個定義來開場，先講硬體與軟體再講應用。之後，我們改成先講農業情境、輸入、輸出與回饋迴路，最後才給數位孿生的定義。
kw_en: why a specialised bioreactor at all
kw_zh: 為什麼需要專門的反應器
figures.q_en: What did the team change about how the Digital Twin is introduced?
figures.q_zh: 團隊改變了數位孿生的哪一種介紹方式？
opt_en: They lead with the agricultural scenario and the feedback loop, and define the twin afterwards
They removed the Digital Twin from the wiki entirely
They replaced the dashboard with a printed report for farmers
They moved the twin from the Software page to the Hardware page
opt_zh: 改成先講農業情境與回饋迴路，之後才給數位孿生的定義
把數位孿生整個從 wiki 上拿掉
把儀表板換成給農民的紙本報表
把數位孿生從軟體頁搬到硬體頁
figures.trap_en: Treating a communication change as not counting as impact. Judges read an explanation that was rebuilt after expert feedback as real integration.
figures.trap_zh: 以為溝通方式的改變不算影響。評審會把「依專家意見重寫的說明」視為真正的整合。

figures.ask_en: Where is this, and what did the team learn here that a laboratory could not have told them?
figures.ask_zh: 這是在哪裡？團隊在這裡學到了什麼是實驗室裡學不到的？
figures.a_en: Ms. Chen Hui-Wen's farm in Tamsui, crouched in a vegetable bed with students looking at the soil. She is one of the farmers on the stakeholder map, and the visit is where the ReLEAF farmer-facing work comes from: her account of how smallholders actually find information is the reason the 農友助手 LINE account exists, and the field conditions she described are what the deployment questions on the Entrepreneurship page have to answer.
figures.a_zh: 這是陳惠文女士在淡水的農場，她蹲在菜畦裡，學生在旁邊一起看土。她是利害關係人地圖上的農民之一，而 ReLEAF 面向農民的工作就是從這次拜訪長出來的：她描述小農實際上怎麼找資訊，是「農友助手」LINE 帳號存在的理由；她講的田間條件，則是創業頁上那些佈署問題必須回答的對象。
figures.q_en: What came out of this farm visit?
figures.q_zh: 這次農場拜訪催生了什麼？
opt_en: The 農友助手 LINE account, built because smallholders could not easily reach the information that already exists
The decision to use Arabidopsis as the model plant
The 0.2 micrometre pore size of the hollow fiber membrane
The choice of green light rather than red light as the induction signal
opt_zh: 「農友助手」LINE 帳號，因為小農不容易取得其實已經存在的資訊而建立
採用阿拉伯芥作為模式植物的決定
中空纖維膜 0.2 微米的孔徑
選擇綠光而非紅光作為誘導訊號
figures.trap_en: Using a field photo as decoration. Each one should carry the sentence 'and this is what we changed because of it'.
figures.trap_zh: 把田間照片當裝飾用。每一張都應該帶著一句「因為這件事，我們改了什麼」。
